title: materialized view  insert data slowing down at 22.3
body:
When we create a materialized view based on the local table, we find that the performance of inserting data in version 22.3 deteriorates greatly compared with version 21.3. The time required for inserting data is about two to three times.

We also tested version 21.8, and the insertion performance of version 21.8 is consistent with that of version 21.3, and it feels like it's starting to deteriorate after version 21.8.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Do you have reproducible example?
